findings.claim: ConsoleExTuiRenderer.cs exists at src/Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx/ConsoleExTuiRenderer.cs
findings.reality: File does NOT exist. The ConsoleEx renderer is wired via ChatScreenBridge, ScreenSession, InlineAgentStreamBridge, and ChatScreenLayout — no top-level ConsoleExTuiRenderer.cs is present.
findings.evidence: find src/Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx -maxdepth 1 -name '*.cs' returns empty; README.md confirms integration but via different entry points.

findings.claim: ConsoleEx project has PublishAot=true
findings.reality: Project uses IsAotCompatible=true. Global Directory.Build.props sets PublishAot=false; ConsoleEx.csproj does not override it.
findings.evidence: src/Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx/Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx.csproj contains <IsAotCompatible>true</IsAotCompatible> but no PublishAot. Directory.Build.props line 61: <PublishAot>false</PublishAot>.

findings.claim: AnsiWriter.EndFrame writes to Stream.WriteAsync (_buf.AsMemory(0,_len))
findings.reality: AnsiWriter writes to ITerminalBackend.WriteAsync, which in production is StdoutBackend. The doc describes an older sketch API.

findings.claim: ConsoleExTuiRenderer.cs exists at project root, implementing RunInteractiveAsync/ReadLineAsync/SetSlashHandler
findings.reality: File does NOT exist. No class in src/Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx/ inherits BaseTuiRenderer.

findings.claim: New UiMsg records: MousePress, MouseRelease, MouseWheel, Paste, TerminalResized
findings.reality: These records do NOT exist in Harbor.Ui.Framework.State.UiMsg. The actual UiMsg contains Agent, KeyInput, Viewport, HistoryMeasured, TogglePanel, FocusPanel, CyclePanelFocus, ResizePanel, ScrollResetToTail, ScrollClamp, SeedPanels.

findings.claim: Input adapters: KittyKeyboardAdapter.cs, LegacyKeyAdapter.cs, MouseAdapter.cs, PasteAdapter.cs as separate files
findings.reality: These files do NOT exist. Input handling is implemented via InputEvent.cs, KeyEvent.cs, MouseEvent.cs, PasteEvent.cs, ResizeSignal.cs, FocusRouter.cs, MouseRouter.cs — no adapter layer with those names.
findings.evidence: find src/Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx/Input -name '*.cs' shows no KittyKeyboardAdapter, LegacyKeyAdapter, MouseAdapter, or PasteAdapter.

findings.claim: TerminalInputSource reads raw bytes into Channel<RawChunk>
findings.reality: TerminalInputSource produces InputEvent structs (not RawChunk) and posts them to a channel. There is no RawChunk type.
findings.evidence: src/Harbor.Tui.ConsoleEx/Input/TerminalInputSource.cs uses Channel<InputEvent>; no RawChunk.cs exists in Input/.

findings.claim: PublishAot=true (opt-in, первый AOT-проект TUI)
findings.reality: Same as F2. The project uses IsAotCompatible=true while PublishAot defaults to false globally.

findings.claim: ITerminalModeController has Enter/Restore/IsRaw
findings.reality: CONFIRMED. ITerminalModeController.cs exists with Enter(), Restore(), and IsRaw property.

findings.reality: CONFIRMED. All three exist: ChatViewReducer in Harbor.Ui.Framework.Reducers, StreamingSync and ChunkedBuffer in Harbor.Ui.Framework.State.

findings.evidence: src/Harbor.Tui.Ansi/AnsiTuiRenderer.cs line 172. Console.Out default AutoFlush behavior in .NET.

top_issues: ConsoleExTuiRenderer.cs referenced in design docs does not exist — renderer integration uses different entry points (ChatScreenBridge, ScreenSession, InlineAgentStreamBridge).
UiMsg records for mouse/paste/resize (MousePress, MouseRelease, MouseWheel, Paste, TerminalResized) are documented in consoleex-design.md but are absent from actual UiMsg.cs.

Input adapter files (KittyKeyboardAdapter, LegacyKeyAdapter, MouseAdapter, PasteAdapter) are documented but not implemented; input is handled via InputEvent/KeyEvent/MouseEvent/PasteEvent structs and routers instead.
PublishAot=true is claimed for ConsoleEx but the project uses IsAotCompatible=true while PublishAot defaults to false globally.
ResultGuard is extensively documented in cse-full-design.md and rop-final-mile.md as deleted, yet it never exists in src/ — only referenced in generated bin/ XML docs.
DiffPreviewViewModel still uses the Contains('Wrote ') heuristic in Terminal.Abstractions, contradicting the widgets doc claim that it was replaced by typed events.
SSRF guard in WebFetchTool and 14 builtin tool count are confirmed accurate.
AnsiTuiRenderer line-count breakdown (629 total) is confirmed exact.
